verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt served at mailchimp.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). A docs-md probe returned a markdown-formatted page that links to .md variants such as developer.md, which suggests agent-readable markdown docs exist even though the probed path itself 404'd. Missing for 10: the llms.txt reads like a generic auto-generated 'web content analysis' rather than curated developer/API docs; no first-party documentation describes the agent-oriented docs offering; no confirmed working markdown docs page; no independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these files effectively.
